# Fábio Magalhães | Revenue & Enterprise Systems Architect · London

> Personal portfolio for Fábio Magalhães, a Revenue & Enterprise Systems Architect based in London, UK.

## Who I am
Fábio Magalhães designs the architecture connecting how companies acquire, sell, price/quote, contract, bill, onboard, serve and retain customers: Salesforce/CRM architecture, revenue architecture (lead-to-cash, CPQ, billing), data architecture and governance, enterprise platform strategy, and AI-enabled workflows layered on top.

## Track record
- Hilton: Enterprise Salesforce governance, 7,000+ users, 100+ global business units
- Farfetch: Salesforce Product Ownership / Centre of Excellence, data governance, 2,500+ discrepancies resolved
- RealVNC: Platform modernisation (Salesforce, MuleSoft, Zuora), 40% reduction in platform incidents
- Staffbase: Enterprise revenue platform strategy (Salesforce/CPQ/data/AI), $3M technology portfolio
- Lunio: MEDDPIC qualification framework and Bowtie lifecycle model implementation

## Availability
Open to permanent enterprise platform / revenue systems leadership roles, and selected fractional or advisory engagements.
